name: route-alert
description: Classify incoming alerts, resolve target channels, format messages, and dispatch notifications

agents.name: alert-classifier
agents.prompt: Parse the incoming alert payload and classify its severity and category

agents.name: channel-resolver
agents.prompt: Determine which notification channels should receive this alert based on routing rules

agents.name: message-formatter
agents.prompt: Format the alert message for each target channel (Slack, email, SMS, webhook)

agents.name: dispatch-sender
agents.prompt: Send formatted messages to all resolved channels and report delivery status
